main.description: A Mini App: a web app that runs inside Krao (sandboxed frame or WebView) and talks to it over postMessage. It runs only once Krao's reviewers approved this exact version (CID); changing the record sends it back for review.

url.description: Where the Mini App is served: https, on an origin other than Krao's web app.

permissions.description: What the Mini App may ask for: 'identity' (who the user is), 'wallet' (a linked wallet address), 'sign' (message signatures), 'transaction' (transactions). Each is confirmed by the user.

chains.description: CAIP-2 chains the Mini App uses; Krao supports eip155:8453 (Base).
